title: VASP Pt: spin-orbit bands and spin Hall conductivity
summary: Fcc platinum from a VASP run with spin-orbit coupling: the PAO Hamiltonian (5D 6S 6P 7S 7P), its band structure and the spin Hall conductivity sigma^z_xy as a function of the Fermi level. Needs your own VASP runs and POTCAR.

steps.label: Pt bands and spin Hall conductivity
steps.note: needs the VASP runs of nscf/ (vasprun.xml, WAVECAR, POTCAR); writes output/ (shcEf_z_xy.dat), Pt_soc_VASP.png and Pt_shc_VASP.png
